premise: The Survival of the Entire Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition After Their Ship Was Crushed.
hook: Their ship was trapped and crushed by Antarctic pack ice, stranding twenty-eight men on floating ice floes for months.
key_facts: Led the Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition which set sail in 1914.
The ship, Endurance, was trapped and eventually sunk by pack ice in the Weddell Sea.
Navigated a small lifeboat across 800 miles of stormy ocean to reach South Georgia Island for rescue.
Successfully saved the lives of every member of his crew without a single casualty.

premise: The brilliant Indian mathematician who calculated the exact height of Mount Everest while working as a low-level computer in colonial India.
hook: He calculated the roof of the world using complex geometry, yet his name was initially entirely absent from history books.
key_facts: Joined the Great Trigonometrical Survey of India in 1831 as a 'computor'.
Invented new mathematical formulas for spherical trigonometry and surveying.
Calculated the height of Peak XV (later named Mount Everest) in 1852.
His exact calculation of 29,002 feet remained the accepted standard for decades.

premise: How a blinded French teenager took a military night-writing code and simplified it into a tactile alphabet that empowered millions.
hook: He was blinded by an accidental workshop injury at age three, yet revolutionized global literacy before turning twenty.
key_facts: Attended the Royal Institution for Blind Youth in Paris using embossed books that were extremely difficult to read.
Adapted an artillery night-writing code based on raised dots created by Charles Barbier.
Published his reading and writing system for the blind in 1829 using a six-dot cell.
The system was universally adopted long after his death from tuberculosis in 1852.

premise: A college dropout who initially traded in ball-bearings builds a massive Indian supermarket retail empire from scratch.
hook: He started his career as a modest stock market speculator before building the country's most profitable retail chain.
key_facts: Dropped out of Mumbai University commerce studies after his father's death.
Initially traded in the stock market before launching the Avenue Supermarts retail chain.
Founded the D-Mart supermarket brand in 2002.
Became one of India's wealthiest self-made entrepreneurs.

premise: A struggling single mother living on state benefits writes a fantasy manuscript in Edinburgh cafes while trying to navigate extreme personal hardship.
hook: She wrote her multi-billion-dollar magical world on napkins and cheap paper while surviving on welfare.
key_facts: Lived in Edinburgh as a single mother on state support.
Completed the first Harry Potter manuscript amidst financial distress.
Received multiple rejections from publishing houses before acceptance.
The book series became a global publishing phenomenon.

premise: An experienced mountain guide rises from humble origins as a yak herder to face freezing winds, thin oxygen, and sheer cliffs on the ultimate mountaineering quest.
hook: He faced freezing winds and oxygen starvation to achieve what no human had ever done before.
key_facts: Started as a high-altitude porter and working-class guide in the Himalayas.
Participated in multiple previous British expeditions to Everest.
Reached the summit of Mount Everest alongside Edmund Hillary on May 29, 1953.
Became an international symbol of mountaineering achievement.
